newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firms with futures in dead market.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firms with futures in dead market.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil firmed slightly on Thursday but the market was very quiet, traders said.
Jet fuel barges were assessed at around June IPE gas oil +$18/+$20 a tonne fob ARA. June IPE gas oil settled $1.25 higher at $174.50 a tonne.
Swaps were also slightly firmer with a June swap done at around +$20.
Traders said trading activity had been fairly dismal although many were holding out for stronger demand into June.
